# Chris Scalia named to N2Growth 2026 Leaders40 Top CHRO List


November 16, 2026


Share


-
-
-
-


Chris Scalia, executive vice president and chief human resources officer at Johnson Controls, has been named to the[N2Growth 2026 Leaders40 Top CHRO list](https://www.n2growth.com/top-chro-list-the-people-leaders-to-watch/) . The recognition reflects the work underway across Johnson Controls to build the talent and capabilities needed to support the company’s growth.


“I’m humbled to be recognized by Tony and his team at N2Growth alongside peers that I have respected and learned from over many years,” Scalia said. “None of us do this work alone, and so this personal recognition is merely a broader reflection of the teammates that I have been privileged to lead and learn from at both Johnson Controls and The Hershey Company.”


At Johnson Controls, Scalia and his team are responsible for the company’s long-term talent, leadership, safety and culture strategies. Their work includes strengthening skills in critical roles, supporting frontline sellers, manufacturing teams and technicians, and simplifying work through continuous improvement and AI.


The company’s talent system is designed to anticipate the people and skills needed by the business and develop those capabilities before demand becomes urgent. Working alongside the Johnson Controls business system, it connects talent development and performance with how teams serve customers and pursue growth opportunities.


Scalia joined Johnson Controls in July 2025 after nearly 20 years at The Hershey Company, where he served as chief human resources officer. His 25-year career spans human resources, talent and leadership, business operations, transformation, employment law, labor relations and safety.
